environment.description: ECS Fargate service in us-west-2 VPC behind Application Load Balancer with listener-level mutual TLS configured. ALB listener attribute routing.http.x-amzn-mtls-clientcert-subject is propagated. The ALB trust store references an internal ACM PCA subordinate CA (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-west-2:123456789012:certificate-authority/a1b2c3d4-5678-90ab-cdef-EXAMPLE11111) with revocation checking via CRL hosted in S3. Listener mutual_authentication block specifies mode=verify, trust_store_arn pointing to the PCA-backed trust store, and ignore_client_certificate_expiry=false. Only clients presenting a valid leaf certificate chaining to the internal PCA root are forwarded to the target group. Additionally, the VPC has no internet gateway attached; all egress routes through a NAT gateway with restrictive NACLs. Container port 8080 is only reachable from the ALB's ENI security group (sg-0alb1234). Task networking mode is awsvpc with no public IP assignment.

config.nacl_rules: deny all inbound except ALB subnet CIDR on ephemeral ports
